plan_summary: Inspect the required public APIs, authenticate to Spotify through Supervisor-provided credentials, find the exact Velvet Underground album across all search pages, inspect every song and select the highest-play-count track, play it, verify the selected identity and playback response, then complete the action task.

steps.reasoning: The public documentation for every task API must be inspected before any task API is called.
verification_targets: Public documentation is retrieved for every API used later.

steps.reasoning: Spotify credentials must come from the Supervisor APIs and remain in variables without exposing passwords or tokens.
steps.action_code:
supervisor_profile = apis.supervisor.show_profile()
account_passwords = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
spotify_accounts = [entry for entry in account_passwords if entry["account_name"].strip().casefold() == "spotify"]
assert len(spotify_accounts) == 1, "A unique Spotify credential entry is required"
spotify_password = spotify_accounts[0]["password"]
spotify_login_result = apis.spotify.login(username=supervisor_profile["email"], password=spotify_password)
spotify_access_token = spotify_login_result["access_token"]
assert isinstance(spotify_access_token, str) and spotify_access_token, "Spotify login must return an access token"
verification_targets: A unique Spotify password is selected without printing it.
Spotify login returns a nonempty access token without printing it.

steps.reasoning: All paginated album search results are needed before identifying the album named in the instruction.
steps.action_code:
album_query_results = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    current_album_page = apis.spotify.search_albums(query="The Velvet Underground", page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    album_query_results.extend(current_album_page)
    if len(current_album_page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1
album_search_summary = [{"album_id": album["album_id"], "title": album["title"], "artists": [artist["name"] for artist in album["artists"]], "release_date": album["release_date"], "song_count": len(album["song_ids"])} for album in album_query_results]
print(album_search_summary)
verification_targets: Every album-search page is retrieved through the first short or empty page.
Candidate album identities, artists, dates, and song counts are available for review.

steps.reasoning: The retrieved public records can now be matched to the unqualified album title and artist in the instruction; if duplicate editions exist, the earliest release provides a deterministic original-edition preference.
steps.action_code:
def normalized_without_leading_the(value):
    normalized = " ".join(value.casefold().split())
    return normalized[4:] if normalized.startswith("the ") else normalized

target_name = normalized_without_leading_the("The Velvet Underground")
title_candidates = [album for album in album_query_results if normalized_without_leading_the(album["title"]) == target_name]
album_candidates = [album for album in title_candidates if any(normalized_without_leading_the(artist["name"]) == target_name for artist in album["artists"])]
assert album_candidates, "No album matched both the requested album title and artist"
earliest_release = min(album["release_date"] for album in album_candidates)
earliest_candidates = [album for album in album_candidates if album["release_date"] == earliest_release]
selected_album = min(earliest_candidates, key=lambda album: album["album_id"])
print({"matched_candidates": [{"album_id": album["album_id"], "title": album["title"], "artists": [artist["name"] for artist in album["artists"]], "release_date": album["release_date"]} for album in album_candidates], "selected_album": {"album_id": selected_album["album_id"], "title": selected_album["title"], "artists": [artist["name"] for artist in selected_album["artists"]], "release_date": selected_album["release_date"]}})
verification_targets: The selected album matches both the normalized title and artist name from the instruction.
Any duplicate editions are resolved only from retrieved release dates and IDs.

steps.reasoning: The most-listened track can only be determined after retrieving the public details of every song listed by the selected album.
steps.action_code:
selected_album_song_ids = list(dict.fromkeys(selected_album["song_ids"]))
assert selected_album_song_ids, "The selected album must contain songs"
album_song_records = []
for song_id in selected_album_song_ids:
    album_song_records.append(apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=song_id))
print([{"song_id": song["song_id"], "title": song["title"], "album_id": song["album_id"], "album_title": song["album_title"], "artists": [artist["name"] for artist in song["artists"]], "play_count": song["play_count"]} for song in album_song_records])
verification_targets: Every unique song ID listed by the selected album is queried.
Public song identities and play counts are available for selection.

steps.reasoning: Immediately before playback, review album membership and compute the maximum play count from the retrieved song records, using a dynamic ID tie-break only if several songs share that maximum.
steps.action_code:
assert {song["song_id"] for song in album_song_records} == set(selected_album_song_ids), "Retrieved songs must cover the album song list"
assert all(song["album_id"] == selected_album["album_id"] for song in album_song_records), "Every retrieved song must belong to the selected album"
maximum_play_count = max(song["play_count"] for song in album_song_records)
most_listened_candidates = [song for song in album_song_records if song["play_count"] == maximum_play_count]
selected_song = min(most_listened_candidates, key=lambda song: song["song_id"])
print({"maximum_play_count": maximum_play_count, "most_listened_candidates": [{"song_id": song["song_id"], "title": song["title"], "album_id": song["album_id"], "play_count": song["play_count"]} for song in most_listened_candidates], "selected_song_id": selected_song["song_id"]})
verification_targets: All inspected songs belong to and cover the selected album.
The playback song is selected from the songs having the maximum retrieved play count.

steps.reasoning: The reviewed song ID and authenticated access token are now available, so the requested playback mutation can be made.
verification_targets: Spotify receives the dynamically selected most-listened song ID for playback.
